structural_reason: the checks that grade a candidate are read from run_all.SKILL_CHECKS in the TRUSTED default-branch checkout, so the row authorizing this bundle cannot exist on a branch the bundle's own commit is not on yet; and it cannot ride in the same tree either, because an authorization whose skill directory is already present reds BOOTSTRAP_ENTRY_STALE. Two landings is the only shape that exists.
unavailability_probed: not assumed: the trusted-side path was run against a real worktree, and one added newline to the candidate tree flipped the refusal from NO_DECLARED_CHECKS to BOOTSTRAP_DIGEST_MISMATCH, which is the authorization doing the work rather than the name

authorization.retired_by: the landing it buys: the commit that lands the bundle deletes the entry in the same commit, because an entry outliving its admission is a standing key for a name
